domain: single aggregate holder; exact-transfer quote; exact current buy/sell/sweep/fee-rescue integer model; native-like 18 and Circle-like 6 decimals; eight isolated launch/economic profiles
limitations: ERC20/native transfer, authorization, external hook, and custody behavior are abstracted
buyback enable/disable is a reduced-model field toggle, not a production Curve transaction
ceilings are illustrative research bounds, not accepted Kuru or Launchpad policy
random histories do not establish exhaustive or symbolic all-configuration coverage
